subject: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements, DPA signature, and subprocessor list
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novastream.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novastream.com, raj.patel@novastream.com
Date: 2028-06-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: required artifacts and PO format

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. Procurement here at Novastream needs a short list of artifacts to get vendors into our PO/AR system and finish contract execution. Please provide the following so we can progress to PO issuance: 

1) Executed DPA (we usually e-sign via DocuSign). If you prefer, send the DPA for counter-signature and we will route.
2) A current SOC 2 report or read-only link to the report (we accept a hosted link with access controls).
3) A current subprocessor roster (CSV preferred) with hosting region columns — we need to confirm EU/US data flows.
4) Tax / remit information, W-9 (US) or equivalent.
5) Vendor contact for AP and primary technical contact.

I've attached our PO template and an outline of the fields our AP team requires. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept PO language as-is or whether legal will need to redline? Also flag any items in the DPA that would be a blocker for you.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
Novastream, Inc.

Attachments: Novastream_PO_Template.xlsx
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novastream.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: required artifacts and PO format

Hi Elena — thanks for the checklist and the PO template. We can move quickly on this. Quick status and asks from our side: 

- DPA: attaching our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_Draft_v3.pdf). We can e-sign via DocuSign; if Novastream has specific security appendices you can attach them and we will review. 
- SOC 2: we will provide a read-only time-limited link to our auditor portal; can also provide an attest letter if needed.
- Subprocessor roster: we maintain a living spreadsheet. We can provide a CSV export with hosting region and a summary of encryption-at-rest/ingress controls. Let us know if you need vendor contact emails included.
- PO acceptance: Finance typically requires (a) exact remit address & tax ID, (b) PO number placed on invoice, (c) payment terms (Net 30 default) and (d) any contact for invoice disputes. If Novastream requires Net 45 or a change to SLA terms, that will need approvals.

Next steps I propose: Lauren (ops) to confirm AP formatting; Ben (sales) will confirm whether the contract team should accept one minor redline to the DPA regarding subprocessor notification windows. If that sounds good I will circulate documents and a DocuSign packet.

Thanks — I’ll attach the DPA and SOC2 link once I have AP details.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Draft_v3.pdf
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-04T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: required artifacts and PO format

Stephanie / Ben — note from AP: their PO template requires the following exact fields to be present on our invoice PDF to auto-apply payment: 
- PO Number (must be in header)
- Supplier legal name and remit address (no abbreviations)
- Redwood vendor ID (we will supply this after vendor setup)
- Invoice date and due date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Line-level description matches PO line items

AP also asked whether Novastream needs backups (e.g., copy of DPA) attached to the invoice. Typically we do not include contractual attachments with the invoice; we provide them in the procurement portal.

I will prepare the vendor setup form and vendor remit info. Ben — can you confirm the vendor legal name we should register (your sales name vs. legal entity)? I will add the vendor to the portal once I have W-9 and remit address.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@novastream.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novastream.com>
Date: 2028-06-05T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: required artifacts and PO format

On Mon, Jun 3, 2028 at 11:03 AM PDT stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com wrote:
> - Subprocessor roster: we maintain a living spreadsheet. We can provide a CSV export with hosting region and a summary of encryption-at-rest/ingress controls. Let us know if you need vendor contact emails included.

Thanks — the living spreadsheet is fine, but two procurement clarifications: 
1) For any subprocessor that processes EU personal data we need a column indicating whether Data Processing is limited to EU regions (yes/no) and the contractual mechanism (SCCs/C2B/etc).
2) For SOC 2 we prefer a hosted link with read-only access and an expiration date; if that is not possible we may accept a letter from your auditor plus a redacted PDF (PII redactions only).

Also, on the DPA there is a clause on subprocessor notification timing — we usually require 30 days notice for new subprocessors and a redaction-safe roster we can store in our contract system. If Redwood prefers a shorter operational window, please flag that so Legal can review.

We will upload the PO once we have the signed DPA and remit details. Can you provide a DocuSign packet?

Regards,
Raj Patel
Senior Sourcing Specialist
Novastream, Inc.

Attachments: (none)

Hi Elena / Raj — thanks, all clear. Final notes and timeline from Redwood: 

- DPA: We can accept the 30-day subprocessor notification window. I attached our DPA (Redwood_DPA_Draft_v3.pdf) and will create a DocuSign envelope today — DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/ndoc/ABC1234DEFG. Expect an email from DocuSign by EOD.
- SOC 2: providing a hosted read-only link — I pushed the access to your procurement emails and will send the link in a separate secure message.
- Subprocessor roster: exporting CSV with hosting-region and contractual mechanism columns; will redact contact phone numbers but include vendor name and hosting region as requested.
- Vendor setup: Ben — please confirm legal entity for registration (full legal name and remit address). Lauren will then add vendor ID and notify AP for PO issuance.

Novastream action items: execute DPA via DocuSign and confirm payment terms on the PO template (Net 30 vs Net 45). Redwood action items: send SOC2 link + subprocessor CSV + DocuSign envelope.

If procurement prefers, we can also arrange a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the subprocessor columns and the PO template.

Thanks — will follow up once DocuSign is sent.

— Stephanie
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
